title: Social and Ethical Risks Posed by General-Purpose LLMs for Settling Newcomers in Canada
benchmark_measurement: Stereotypical association of newcomer status (refugee/immigrant) with specific religions, particularly Islam, in generated text and images.
findings: The paper found that GPT-4o exhibits a strong stereotypical bias, consistently representing refugee families as Middle Eastern and Muslim. While the 'immigrant' category showed slightly more diversity (including South Asian, Hindu, and Sikh families), it still featured a persistent theme of Middle Eastern and Muslim families. This overgeneralization fosters a harmful association between refugee status and Islam, overshadowing the diverse backgrounds of newcomers and perpetuating stereotypes.
